scope: Structured native visual review, not pixel equality. PASS covers the stated component treatment; the separate typography and VM rows remain acceptance boundaries.
rows: 32x32 plates, 16x16 exact glyphs and 4px corners. Neutral hover/pressed and red close states have no generic control shadows. Dedicated focus ring; tertiary backdrop glyphs. Native image-circle leak reset.
48px including the divider; 32px content and 15px total vertical padding. Actual native fixture, not a geometry-only claim.
48px including divider, real entry/dropdown and bordered navigation versus flat search/view/menu. Controls remain 32px.
Both native headers are 48px; 212px sidebar, square internal pane join and coherent shared divider. Outer corners remain structural.

Native state samples visibly distinguish neutral, p600/p700/p800 and danger states, with 4px corners and semantic shadows. GTK3 painted-background tests additionally verify palette without trusting computed color alone.
32px ordinary/icon plates; flat buttons remain unelevated. Real Adw.SplitButton demonstrates asymmetric joined corners.
212px pane; selected p50/p700 row with a 2px left indicator inset 9px vertically. Native target is 34px plus 2px row gap.
Card elevation and 8px structure differ from unelevated boxed lists. Card heading/divider/body hierarchy now follows the reference.

50px minimum, padding, separators and title/subtitle colors are implemented and inspected. Real EntryRow/PasswordEntryRow/SpinRow own editable layouts rather than HTML's right-aligned input equivalents; natural font metrics and expanded content can exceed 50px.
Native grouped toggles use a radius-6 surface2 container, 2px padding/gap, 28px children and selected white/control elevation.
36px target, text emphasis and 2px inset active underline. GTK3 removes its orientation-specific stock underline and uses the label for exact 10px inset; unsupported weight650 translates to600.

Container and 28px treatment are native. Label-only Gtk.StackSwitcher matches the reference gallery; real Adw.ViewSwitcher is also tested and adds toolkit-required page icons, so its content differs from the iconless HTML example.
32px entries and native focus, realistic dropdown labels and >=150px minimum; nested rows reset so they do not stretch the header. GTK3 avoids double combobox borders.
Native chooser and spin controls are themed and functional; toolkit-owned color/font preview and value/text sizing differ from the simplified HTML swatch/value examples.

Native unchecked/checked/mixed/disabled and focus examples; selected p500. Switch allocations are 40x22 with a 16px bordered, shadowed thumb. Disabled indicator opacity no longer compounds with the parent.
Exact component trough colors, 8px progress, eight discrete level blocks with six filled, 2px gaps and radius2. Native range thumb remains circular.
Real GtkSpinner uses a generated 20px vector with a 2px p200 ring and p600 top arc, rotating through native CSS at 800ms. Factory alignment prevents stretching the icon across a vertical card.

Complete native popup surface: 205px plate, radius8, white .97, strong surface shadow, flat 32px Open/Rename/Duplicate rows and a text-danger Trash row. Toolkit arrow and keyboard accelerators remain native additions; the reference has no arrow.
p50/p200 surface, 8px radius, padding and 28px primary Install treatment verified. Adw.Banner centers its message and does not expose HTML's leading info glyph layout through theme CSS.

Dark #222226 surface, radius8, surface shadow, p300 Undo and spacing verified. Adw.ToastWidget retains its close control and its native minimum/layout produces a wider surface than HTML's max-width360; GTK CSS has no max-width property.

Real Adw.AlertDialog has radius8, dedicated dialog shadow, padded message and surface2 divided footer with Cancel/Discard. Libadwaita response layout distributes the buttons equally rather than using HTML's compact right-aligned actions.
Native 48px p50 tile, p600 glyph and reference title/description styling. Uses the available symbolic search glyph for the same empty-search meaning.

Real Gtk.ColumnView, native selection model, exact reference sample data and three columns. Header uses text3/surface2 and 1.4:.8:.8 allocation; selected document uses p50/p800 separately from sidebar p700.

Actual pointer-triggered native tooltip has #222226 background, white text, 4px radius, 6/8 padding and 11px type. Explicit background/child resets prevent a stock white tooltip from masking the rule.
Real scroller with excess content and programmatic scrolling; quiet transparent track and 6px #B9BAC1 thumb. Native overlay fading remains toolkit behavior.
Real Gtk.ScrolledWindow with 30 extra rows, overlay mode and actual scrolling. Same quiet thumb palette and transparent trough.

Native theme capture and painted colors support control/range parity. GTK3 cannot express weight650 and uses600; its notebook, chooser and subtitle/header layout APIs differ from libadwaita. Full desktop integration still needs the VM.

Strong sans-serif and system-ui mappings pass. Required Plus Jakarta Sans is absent, so both native and reference captures use installed fallback; exact font test skips77. Glyph metrics/line wrapping cannot be certified until the font is supplied.

Stock gtk4-demo launched and captured with user theme overrides; GTK3 fixture also runs without an appearance provider. Stock application's own glyph/theme choices and content layout can differ. Nautilus, Control Center and Majoris Clock are unavailable here.

Shell source grammar/selectors pass against Trixie48.7. WSL Xvfb/Openbox is not a Majoris GNOME Shell/Mutter session; compositor shadows, fractional scaling, Shell states, maximized/restore and desktop-wide input require final VM validation.
